Exercise: Cable Seated Crunch

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
isolation

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- extension_of_the_spine

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- cable

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- abdominal_strengthening

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain or injury

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Bicycle Crunches, equipment: bodyweight
- name: Reverse Hyperextension, equipment: cable

Instructions:

- Seat on a flat bench with your back facing a high pulley.
- Grasp the cable rope attachment with both hands (with the palms of the hands facing each other) and place your hands securely over both shoulders. Tip: Allow the weight to hyperextend the lower back slightly. This will be your starting position.
- With the hips stationary, flex the waist so the elbows travel toward the hips. Breathe out as you perform this step.
- As you inhale, go back to the initial position slowly.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
